# Sensibo

> Sensibo provides AI-powered smart climate control and air quality solutions for homes and businesses, enabling energy savings through intelligent AC management and environmental monitoring.

Sensibo offers a comprehensive ecosystem of smart AC controllers, air quality monitors, and commercial HVAC management platforms integrated with popular voice assistants and smart home systems. The company serves both residential users seeking energy efficiency and commercial clients including hotels, schools, and retail chains.

## Key Topics

- Smart AC Control
- Energy Savings & Efficiency
- Air Quality Monitoring
- Climate React Technology
- Voice Assistant Integration
- Google Home & Amazon Alexa
- Home Automation
- Geo-fencing
- HVAC Management
- Smart Home Integration
- IoT Sensors
- Commercial Climate Control
- Sustainability
- AI-Powered Optimization
- Building Management Systems

## Smart AC Controllers

- [Sensibo Air PRO - Smart AC Controller with Built-in Air Quality Sensor](https://sensibo.com/products/sensibo-air-pro): Premium smart AC controller with integrated air quality sensing and voice assistant compatibility
- [Sensibo Sky - Smart AC Controller](https://sensibo.com/products/sensibo-sky): Smart AC controller with advanced scheduling and climate automation features
- [Sensibo Air - Smart AC Controller](https://sensibo.com/products/sensibo-air): Core smart AC controller enabling home automation and remote AC management
- [Sensibo Air + Room Sensor Bundle](https://sensibo.com/products/sensibo-air-bundle): Smart AC controller bundled with room occupancy and temperature sensor for optimized comfort
- [Sensibo Air Pro + Door Sensor Bundle](https://sensibo.com/products/sensibo-air-pro-door-sensor): Premium AC controller with door/window sensor for enhanced energy management

## Air Quality & Environmental Monitoring

- [Sensibo Pure - Smart HEPA Air Purifier with Pollution Sensing](https://sensibo.com/products/sensibo-pure): Intelligent air purifier with real-time pollution detection and HEPA filtration
- [Sensibo Elements - Smart Indoor Air Quality Monitor](https://sensibo.com/products/sensibo-elements): Comprehensive air quality monitor tracking PM2.5, CO2, TVOC, and environmental metrics
- [Sensibo Room Sensor - Motion, Temperature & Humidity Sensor](https://sensibo.com/products/room-sensor): Multi-function sensor enabling energy-saving automation based on room occupancy and climate conditions
- [Smart Door and Window Sensor](https://sensibo.com/products/door-sensor): Smart sensor for detecting door/window status to optimize AC control and energy efficiency
- [Sensibo Pure Replacement HEPA Filters](https://sensibo.com/products/pure-filters): Replacement filters for Sensibo Pure air purifier maintaining optimal air quality
